svg.title: Component · PicPlace account · signed-in · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors the PICPLACE card of App/SettingsView.swift (picplaceCard, planned) — the optional cloud tier. Two states: signed-out (the sign-in row in accent, its subtitle naming the server, and the Server row with a chevron: tapping it edits the host — Debug builds default to picplace.test, Release to picplace.co) and signed-in (Account · the PicPlace username; This device · the name this install registered under, which is what other devices see in a project's Also on row and in the server's device list; On PicPlace · how many of this library's projects have a copy and the bytes they take there; Server, read-only while signed in; Sign out… in record red — it revokes THIS device's tokens on the server and keeps every local file). Sign in opens ASWebAuthenticationSession on the server's /oauth/authorize (PKCE); the consent screen is the server's own page, so no mirror exists for it here. Sits between STORAGE and ADVANCED: it is about where projects live. Shared by the Mac (Settings shares the iOS spec).
